text: Reproduction with the authors' code (PR-AUC, iML1515: 1,326 genes x 25 carbon sources = 33,150 pairs): iML1515 as released 0.613; + the five Bernstein vitamins 0.693; Bernstein all-corrections model with its saved vitamin supplies 0.839 (published 0.843; the 0.004 gap is attributed to solver/library versions and is reported, not hidden). Other releases in the same pipeline: iJO1366 0.621, iAF1260 0.638, iJR904 0.659 (different matched gene sets, so not directly comparable). Our label-free 19-compound cofactor set added to iML1515 scored 0.548: blanket supplementation removes true essentiality calls (no-growth pairs fall from 2,171 to 1,249) and is a NEGATIVE. No SOTA claim is made. The pre-registered split-half search for additional supplements on top of the corrected all-corrections model is reported in the ledger when complete.
